'''Starlight Shores''' is a [[world]] in ''[[The Sims 3: Showtime]]'' expansion pack. It was announced officially in an [[Electronic Arts|EA]] press release.

==Overview==
Starlight Shores is a city that was shipped with The Sims 3: Showtime. It is loosely based on a Californian-type urban area, specifically Hollywood. It has a park, coffeehouses, Show venues, etc., and some of the rabbit holes were combined with venues or a new shell to the outside was added.

There is also a beach with houses along the coastline. The houses seem to be between modern and old styled. Most of the very expensive houses have families living in them. There is one unique house that consists of two lots. The first lot being big, with the main house and a pool, and the second lot being small, has a poolhouse and garage. The lots are neatly placed that it appears to be one long lot. These lots house the Buckshot families.

Simfests are held in Starlight Shores, Magicians and Acrobats and Singers alike will find many opportunities to express their talent (or their non-talent) with lots of community lots with stages and performing areas.

These two Sims are young and aren't quite sure what they want out of life...But for now, they're content to spend their time getting tans on the beach and having picnics in the park. Can these two find their way, or will they spend their lives drifting aimlessly?''

*'''[[Buckshot household]]''' ''12 Buckshot Lane''
:§47,000
:Difficulty: 2
:[[Madeline Buckshot]], [[Finnegan Sawyer]]
:''The perfect celebrity marriage gone wrong, Madeline kicked her famous singer husband to the pool house and now lives with her new love interest, Finnegan. Does Finnegan truly love Madeline, or is he using her for a nice place to live and leg up in his singing career? Was Madeline being too hasty in kicking her former husband to the curb?''

*'''[[Charlie Ray Buckshot|Buckshot family]]''' ''12.5 Buckshot Lane''
:§24,000
:Difficulty: 1
:[[Charlie Ray Buckshot]]
:''What was supposed to be a temporary relocation to the pool house became a permanent for Charlie Ray after a sudden divorce from his wife Madeline. Charlie still has his music to keep him going, and luckily this pool house is nicer than most normal houses in town. Will Charlie ever get back together with Maddy, or will he live in the pool house forever?''

*'''[[Steve Cupp|Cupp family]]''' ''177 Foothill Drive''
:§40,000
:Difficulty: 1
:[[Steve Cupp]]
:''A world renowned magician who loves traveling, Steve has a knack for dazzling Sims with his grand illusions. He lives in solitude with only his artifacts and memories of a life of adventure to keep him company. Will Steve's adventurous lead to one too many close calls?''

*'''[[Crash Pad household]]''' ''22 Palm Park Ave''
:§3,300
:Difficulty: 3
:[[Mimi Olivia]], [[Willard Wright]], [[Richter Steele]], [[Becky Lack]]
:''A mishmash of Sims from all walks of life, this group isn't for the faint of heart. Between a great cook, runaway teen, wannabe writer, and muscly health nut, everyone in this household miraculously gets along for now. What will the future hold for this diverse group of Sims trying to make it in the city?''

*'''[[Dueling Singers household]]''' ''656 Vista Blvd''
:§4,700
:Difficulty: 2
: [[Rich Richmond]], [[Sadie Mason]], [[Mercedes May]]
:''Rich and Sadie are a happy couple who invited their friend Mercedes to move in with them. The original plan was for Sadie to help Mercedes jump start her Singing career, but now Sadie is worried Mercedes is garnering her fame. Worst yet, Mercedes has taken a liking to Sadie's boyfriend Rich as well. Did Sadie make a mistake in inviting Mercedes into her home, or will Mercedes attempts to steal both Sadie's boyfriend and fans fall flat?''

*'''[[Elson family]]''' ''73 Oceanview Drive''
:§1,700
:Difficulty: 2
:[[Craig Elson]], [[Emily Elson]]
:''Craig and Emily are high school sweethearts who just got married and are excited to spend their lives together! Recent transplants to the city after Emily's job transfer, these two show aficionados are itching to make the most of the star-studded town. Will the distractions of the town over whelm these two newlyweds, or will they settle down and start a family as they'd planned?''

*'''[[Gooder family]]''' ''56 Oceanview Drive''
:§100,000
:Difficulty: 3
:[[Edward Gooder]], [[Annabel Gooder]], [[Natasha Gooder]], [[Sebastian Gooder]]
:''Prim, proper, and absolutely high-society, the Gooders are old money Sims that despise the Best family next door and their nouveau riche ways. Edward and Annabel prefer to keep to themselves rather than associate with "unsavory" people. Natasha, however, clearly doesn't feel this way, and is secretly dating Calvin Best. Will her parents come to terms about Natasha's love for Calvin?''

*'''[[Khan household]]''' ''465 Shoreline Point''
:§4,700
:Difficulty: 2
:[[Ernesto Gonzalez]], [[Mithun Khan]], [[Ariella Chen]]
:''Mithun and Ariella's relationship was great until they gained a permanent houseguest in the form of Mithun's friend Ernesto. The guys have been close their whole lives, but Ariella views Ernesto as a mooch and wants him out! With Mithun's reluctance to ask Ernesto to leave, will Ariella and Mithun continue their happy relationship?''

*'''[[Kirstin Law|Law family]]''' ''118 Foothill Drive''
:§2,400
:Difficulty: 1
:[[Kirstin Law]]
:''The local trouble maker with penchant for fine art, Kirstin's name is one many police reports, but her top notch thievery keeps her out of jail. Will Kirstin continue to evade the law, or is her time as a master thief coming to an end?''

*'''[[Lee family]]''' ''358 Hill Street''
:§3,100
:Difficulty: 2
:[[Sonoko Lee]], [[Mitch Lee]]
:''Sonoko is a realist, and Mitch likes to dream big. Sonoko lacks confidence in her husband's ambition to make a living as a DJ and is convinced it won't last long. Is she right or will Mitch prevail in his dream to spin the vinyl?''

*'''[[Yolanda Lemmon|Lemmon family]]''' ''456 Shoreline Point''
:§60,000
:Difficulty: 1
:[[Yolanda Lemmon]]
:''The widow of the late infamous Jimmy Lemmon, Yolanda is an accomplished performer who keeps to herself but has a knack for sensational performances. Her house is large for one person, but she likes the emptiness of it. Will love surprise Yolanda, or will she be content to stay single?''

*'''[[Darren Lott|Lott family]]''' ''19 Palm Park Ave''
:§900
:Difficulty: 1
:[[Darren Lott]]
:''An out-of-towner looking for a second chance, Darren is out to show the ladies he's the next big thing. His relationships has been easy come, easy go, but Darren doesn't seem to mind. A liar and cheater at heart, Darren's second chance seems to be going the same way as his first. Can he turn things around and find true love? Does he even want to?''

*'''[[Luck family]]''' ''258 Foothill Drive''
:§19,000
:Difficulty: 2
:[[Wylie Luck]], [[Chad Luck]], [[Isaac Luck]]
:''Three very different brothers just inherited their great aunt's estate and are once reunited under one roof. Each brother followed his own path in life, One brother is now a thrilling Acrobat, another is a hard working Band Manager, and the third is a smooth talker who managed to get by on his looks alone. Will this diverse set of brothers bond together, or will their differences get the best of them?''

*'''[[Martin family (Starlight Shores)|Martin family]]''' ''214 Foothill Drive''
:§19,000
:Difficulty: 3
:[[Wayne Martin]], [[Aurora Martin]], [[Nigel Martin]]
:''A celebrity chef, beautiful wife, and a charming son, the Martins are the envy of many Sims. Really, the only thing this perfect family has to complain about is Wayne's love of fishing, which his wife and son can't seem to understand.''

*'''[[Javed Meir|Meir family]]''' ''18 Palm Park Ave''
:§1,600
:Difficulty: 1
:[[Javed Meir]]
:''Javed is talented, hard-working, and well-read, but strangely has a hard time looking for true love. Will Javed find the love hes looking for, or will he have to settle for success as his only companion?''

*'''[[Platt family]]''' ''107 Foothill Drive''
:§4,700
:Difficulty: 3
:[[Danielle Platt]], [[Alora Platt]], [[Robbie Platt]]
:''The Platt household consists of two adorable children and mother who loves them. Danielle wishes the best, but things can get out of control at times as she struggles to pay the bills and raise two youngsters. Can the Platts stay afloat on Danielle's limited income?''

*'''[[Sagar family]]''' ''230 Foothill Drive''
:§13,000
:Difficulty: 2
:[[Rehman Sagar]], [[Talan Sagar]]
:''A single father who wants to see his kid succeed, Rehman pushes Talan to get good grades and to have a real career. But Talan aspires to be on stage as a hot shot performer. Will Talan achieve his of performing, or is he bound to drift away from his father?''

*'''[[Singh family]]''' ''257 Starry Way''
:§800
:Difficulty: 2
:[[Matias Singh]], [[Priscilla Singh]]
:''Matias and Priscilla have been down on their luck recently, but they are both optimistic that life in a new town can turn things around. Priscilla hopes to be a big time Magician and set the world ablaze with fancy tricks, and Matias has a beautiful voice (if only he can be discovered.) Will the Singh family reach stardom, or are they headed straight to the poor house?''

*'''[[Whitfield family]]''' ''447 Shoreline Point''
:§25,000
:Difficulty: 3
:[[Jamar Whitfield]], [[Diane Whitfield]], [[Barry Whitfield]], [[Lela Whitfield]]
:''The Whitfields are the quintessential showbiz family. On the surface they may seem to have fame, fortune and talent, but a life in the entertainment world isn't always glamorous. Will this family's need to be in the spotlight put a strain on their relationships?''

*'''[[Woods family]]''' ''108 Foothill Drive''
:§1,140
:Difficulty: 3
:[[Brandon Woods]], [[Stardust Woods]], [[August Woods]]
:''The Woods aren't always the most popular family on the block. This isn't because they love trees, but they don't want the city to expand (and protest anything that will cause an urban sprawl). Longtime residents support their cause but performers and proprietors feel differently. Will the Woods succeed in saving the town, or will they further outcast themselves from the community?''

*'''[[Worthington family]]''' ''638 Vista Blvd''
:§3,100
:Difficulty: 2
:[[Girbits Worthington]], [[Melanie Worthington]]
:''A sweet grandmother and a kid who can't remember his own name, the Worthingtons lead very different social lives. Melanie loves to entertain friends, while Girbits stays locked in his room playing video games. Will Girbits ever get that first kiss, or will he forever stay single?''

==Notes==
*There are '''new rabbitholes''' in the town, and if:
:*''[[The Sims 3: Ambitions|Ambitions]]'' is installed, four lots will be replaced with Barney's Salon and Tattoo, Landgraab Sell n' Swap, Community Fire Department and Grady's Junkstop (all of them are used from lot bins)
:*''[[The Sims 3: Pets|Pets]]'' is installed, a big lot will be replaced with JRA International Equestrian Center.

==Trivia==
*It is set as a '''"Southern California" town''', like Hollywood/Los Angeles/Beverly Hills, as there is a reference to it.
*The town description makes a note that monks founded the town 300 years ago. Los Angeles was founded by the Franciscan order in 1771.
*Palms resembling ''Washington robusta'' palms line the streets in Starlight Shores.
*At Broad Street Business Tower & Grill, there is a big poster stuck on one side of the wall. It is a reference to ''[[wikipedia:Battlefield 3|Battlefield 3]]'', a game made by [[wikipedia:EA Digital Illusions CE|EA Digital Illusions CE]] and published by [[Electronic Arts]].
*The Starlight Shores Sign is suggestive of the [[Wikipedia:Hollywood Sign|Hollywood Sign]], which is a Los Angeles landmark.
* Despite being called a city in the description, Starlight Shores is still considered a suburb in-game, meaning [[Bridgeport]] is still the only official city in ''[[The Sims 3: Late Night]]''. This was likely done to maintain compatibility with the base game. Players who wish to have it be considered a city will need to modify the game files themselves.
*The city hall bears a strong resemblance to the city hall of Beverly Hills and to a lesser extent, those in Los Angeles and San Diego.
*The Brotherhood of Fine Fellows Hall is based off the Sunset Tower in Hollywood.
*The Jimmy Lemmon Memorial Mausoleum is based on the Bon Marche Pavilion built for the 1925 Paris International Exhibition of Modern Decorative and Industrial Arts.
*The Community Library is loosely based on the original Los Angeles County Museum of Art buildings.
*Rodeo-Go-Go references Whisky-a-Go-Go, but is thematically based on the Saddle Ranch Chop House at 8371 Sunset Blvd.
*MN8 is roughly based on the Whisky-a-Go-Go building at 8901 Sunset Blvd.
*The Broad Street Business Tower & Grill is based on the City National Bank Branch, located at 9229 Sunset Blvd.
*The Los Sueños Private Club is based on the former Standard West Hollywood Hotel at 8300 Sunset Boulevard.
*The Market Basket grocery store is partially based off a bank building at 8150 Sunset Blvd.
*The name of the Brotherhood of Fine Fellows may be a reference to the [[Wikipedia:Independent Order of Odd Fellows|Independent Order of Odd Fellows]]{{confirm}}
*The Binder Clips Center is a clear reference to the Staples Center in Los Angeles, the home of the NBA's Los Angeles Lakers and Clippers and the NHL's Los Angeles Kings.

'''Sims University''' is a university [[sub-neighborhood|sub-world]] that appears in ''[[The Sims 3: University Life]]''. It acts similar to the vacation worlds from ''[[The Sims 3: World Adventures]]''. Only [[Sim]]s who are aged from [[Young Adult]] to [[Elder]] can travel to the university. A large number of dormitories, frat and sorority homes are available for [[Sim]]s to rent spots in, as are rental residential houses.

There is a gym, a pool, a diner called Sim Burger,<ref group="note">Rabbit hole</ref> a coffee shop where the rebels hang out, a bar with a bowling alley where the jocks hang out, and the hobby shop where the nerds hang out.

There are also classrooms which are interactive.

By default, many [[rabbit hole]]s are absent from the sub-world, including ones that student Sims can use if they are added manually, such as [[bistro]], [[spa]], [[hospital]], and [[mausoleum]], as well as any that were added in non-''University Life'' packs.

If ''[[The Sims 3: Pets]]'' is installed, a solo-Sim household who also owns one or more pets will have a notification show up when the Sim heads off to Sims University, claiming that "customs agents" won't allow pets "across the border".

==Lots==
56 lots in total are in Sims University: 25 community, 6 empty and 25 residential lots.

==Subdistricts==
Sims University de facto (and de jure) has no subdistricts, as the town has a very compact structure where town facilities are rarely far away. Some parks (e.g. Senior Lake Park, Woodland Park), and most of the very long [[hiking trail]]s, can be difficult to set up time for player Sims to visit on an 18-credit semester schedule, but other than those, almost the entire town is within 35min by [[taxi]].

'''Oasis Landing''' is a futuristic sub-[[world]] that was shipped with ''[[The Sims 3: Into the Future]]''. It is set in the distant future, relative to other worlds in [[The Sims (series)|''The Sims'' series]]. Sims can engineer children, something that is not possible anywhere else. They can buy (or build) a [[Plumbot]], or sell one to the masses, set up a digiblast display, or even buy new high-tech stuff from the imports gallery. Unlike other sub-worlds in ''[[The Sims 3]]'', Sims are able to stay in Oasis Landing indefinitely.[https://youtu.be/K3H-Y9zYafQ?t=1644 The Sims 3 Live Broadcast - July 30, 2013] on "The Sims" YouTube Channel There are three types of Oasis Landing: normal, utopian and dystopian.[https://twitter.com/CurtisParadis/status/370172224575377408 Time Almanac] The player starts out in the normal future, but can alter it to a utopian or dystopian future by tampering with certain aspects of life in the present. It is the only Maxis-created Sims 3 world to have no large saltwater bodies, making it impossible to place a [[diving area]] in it. However, saltwater can be found by digging with the terrain modifier in lots placed in the wasteland, while [[mermaid]] Sims{{Vgversion|TS3:IP}} can swim in the dam and Wasteland ZEPHYR stop lakes to keep their tail, despite the transition-to-human [[moodlet]] specifying saltwater. By default, Oasis Landing is missing some base game [[rabbit hole]]s that would work normally there, including [[Grocery|groceries]], [[diner]]s, and regular [[stadium]]s. ==Cultural references== Oasis Landing and the lifestyle, families, and objects in it are full of references to science-fiction and fantasy franchises, with much more references than any other world in ''The Sims 3'' or its expansion packs, with only [[Midnight Hollow]] being even close. The references range from the very obvious (''[[wikipedia:Back to the Future (franchise)|Back to the Future]]'', ''Star Wars'', ''[[:wikipedia:Futurama|Futurama]]'') to various small and medium-sized references to more than a dozen franchises that span more than a century of media ranging from [[:wikipedia:H. G. Wells|H. G. Wells]] to ''[[:wikipedia:The Hunger Games|The Hunger Games]]''. changes are likely possibilities. |} ==Utopian and Dystopian versions== Depending on various [[opportunities]], [[almanac of time]] options, and [[Advanced Technology]] skill levels, the Sim can alter the course of the future and make Oasis Landing a utopia or a dystopia. Many (but not all) of the version-specific features are added through so-called Cause Effect [[Spawner]]s. ===Utopian Future=== Adds large [[flower]]s that can be collected colored [[dew]] from or shaken, and [[dig site]]s with stones in a circle formation. Most [[tree]]s will have a purple, blue, or pink hue. Local NPCs will use the [[Stride of Pride]] as their walk, whether from the ''Wonderland Sim'' [[hidden trait]] and/or the ''Wonderland'' [[moodlet]]. [[Ball fight|Dew fights]] often take place. ===Dystopian Future=== Adds explorable [[geyser rift]]s, large [[waste pile]]s that can be jumped into or cleaned, smaller bits of waste spread around, and the ability to eat collectible [[Bug collecting#The Sims 3|beetles and butterflies]]. The skies are cloudy and dark. [[Lightning]] strikes occur often and without warning, and [[meteor]] impacts occur often with just seconds of forewarning. [[Pollution]] is a major factor, as most trees will have dark or no leaves, similar to their ''[[The Sims 3: Seasons]]'' winter forms, while most [[shell]] exteriors show tear and wear. [[Gardening (The Sims 3)|Harvestable]] plants do however remain fully functioning, and the air is safe to breathe. [[File:Barnacle Bay Reflect.png|left]]'''Barnacle Bay''' is a [[world]] available for download from [[TheSims3.com|The Sims 3 Store]], as the second world that The Sims 3 Store has released.<ref name="the sims hub">[http://thesimshub.net78.net/barnacle-bay-new-world-coming-to-the-sims-3/ The Sims Hub - New World Coming to The Sims 3]</ref> It is based on a moderately temperatured island with a tourist pirate theme. It became available to download on September 23, 2010. Prior to the release of The Sims 3 Barnacle Bay, the price was 1650 SimPoints,<ref name="barnacle bay released">[http://www.simprograms.com/25509/barnacle-bay-now-available-for-1650-simpoints/ SimPrograms confirmation of Barnacle Bay's release and price].</ref> but after the release of The Sims 3 Barnacle Bay, the price was raised to 2000 SimPoints. As of May 2012, Barnacle Bay is no longer available for purchase with SimPoints. Instead, it was included in a bundle worth US$20 that includes 100 SimPoints and several exclusive contents.<ref>Barnacle Bay SimPoints bundle news [https://simsvip.com/2012/05/25/sims-3-store-barnacle-bay-simpoint-bundle/ on SimsVIP]</ref> Barnacle Bay was also given freely as part of ''[[The Sims 3: Island Paradise]]'' pre-order on Origin.

==Description==
[[File:barnacle-logo-en.png|75px|left]]
'''''A New World Awaits - Escape to Barnacle Bay today!'''''

''An island nestled in the Simuyan Sea, Barnacle Bay is a vibrant vacation getaway with stunning beaches, campgrounds, parks, and a curiously modern downtown. First settled by pirates, fisherman, and artists - the world's inhabitants now enjoy relaxing at Smuggler's Beach and letting loose at The Wanderer's Watering Hole. Will Your trip be a vacation or a staycation?''

==Overview==
Barnacle Bay is by far the city with the deepest connection to the sea and to pirates. The city features four default [[beach]]es. The new clothing and personalities introduced are also outdoor-like, and many Sims possess the [[Angler]] trait.

The town is set after ''[[The Sims 2]]'', as the [[Caliente family|Caliente sisters]] have moved from [[Pleasantview]] to Barnacle Bay, which is confirmed by Dina's biography: ''"The Sims 2 Sisters are back! Can Dina break hearts in Barnacle Bay like she did in Pleasantview? She wants to find out."''

==Backstory==
[[File:Backstory Render BB.png|right]]
'''Ahoy, Matey!'''

Fear me…ye…scurvy…dog… Alright, so I’m not a pirate. But my great, great, grandparents were. They burned, pillaged, looted and merrily stole treasure. It was a pirate’s life for them! They settled here in Barnacle Bay way back in the day, when the island was more about escaping the authorities and less about escaping the drudgery of everyday life. Even though it’s not really dangerous anymore, Barnacle Bay is an amazing place where people of all types come and find a place in the world where they can nestle.

With beautiful beaches, relaxing campgrounds, plentiful parks and a modern downtown area there’s something for everyone here! I mean, have you seen that restaurant? It’s a boat! A boat that crashed! How crazy is that? Haha! So come along for a visit; you just might find yourself wanting to stay.
{{clr}}

**Grab a bite to eat at Hogan's Deep Sea Diner before fishing at Ophelia's Fishing Hole.
**Explore the mystery hidden in Pirate's Hideaway or meet new Sims at The Wanderer's Watering Hole.
**Discover the mysterious Barnacle Bay lore by exploring the abandoned piers of Founder's Beach and the relics found within the Goldbeard Galleon Gallery.

==Misconceptions==
[[File:Barnacle bay cost ea support.jpg|thumb|EA technical support guesses at 1650 SimPoints.]]
*A French gaming site reported that it would cost 600 SimPoints (roughly €6)<ref>[http://www.zonejeu.info/2010/08/une-extension-la-mode-pirates-pour-les.html Zonejeu] ''French'' ([https://translate.google.com/translate?js=y&prev=_t&hl=en&ie=UTF-8&layout=1&eotf=1&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.zonejeu.info%2F2010%2F08%2Fune-extension-la-mode-pirates-pour-les.html&sl=auto&tl=en English translation])</ref> and a Q&A interview on IGN reported that it was 1650, though that information was later removed from the article.<ref name="ign q&a" /> An EA technical support representative mentioned 1650 as well, but stated that it was not certain, as shown in the image on the right.
*In an [http://www.ign.com/ IGN] interview with [[EA]] they refer to Barnacle Bay as an "expansion", though this term is incorrect, as it is merely a downloadable world similar to [[Riverview]]<ref name="ign q&a" />

==Trivia==
* Like Twinbrook, all deceased Sims have grey hair and green skin.
* On January 1, 2011 Barnacle Bay was the daily deal from The Sims 3 Store and was discounted to 1111 SimPoints. On May 22, 2011 it was the daily deal again and was discounted to 1050 SimPoints.
* There are two repairwomen, two elderly social workers, and many more NPCs with different life stages from other games.
* Barnacle Bay was also released in stores, costing $14. The box contains a slip with a code that players can use at The Sims 3 Store to download the town and two sets.<ref name="simprograms">[http://www.simprograms.com/28624/so-i-bought-sims-3-barnacle-bay/]</ref>
* The graveyards on Barnacle Bay don't have ponds. Deathfish are found at the large beach across from the art gallery beside the pier posts.
* Although The Sims 3 Store states that it needs the latest update, Barnacle Bay will work on ''[[The Sims 3: Fast Lane Stuff]]'' (Version 5.0) and [[The Sims 3: Late Night|later]] [[The Sims 3: Outdoor Living|Sims 3]] [[The Sims 3: Generations|games]]. But The Sims 3 Ambitions and prior games will need to be updated.
* In an episode of ''[[Wikipedia:The Simpsons|The Simpsons]]'' titled "[[w:c:simpsons:The Wife Aquatic|The Wife Aquatic]]", the Simpson family take a trip to an island in New England called [[w:c:simpsons:Barnacle Bay|Barnacle Bay]].

It was announced on August 4, 2011 and released on August 25, 2011.http://ea.gamespress.com/release.asp?i=1618 Official EA Confirmationhttps://www.facebook.com/event.php?eid=230928623609679 Official EA confirmation by Facebook event.https://www.outcyders.net/news/the-sims-3-hidden-springs-announcedhttps://www.shacknews.com/article/69590/sims-3-getting-hidden-springs-dlc-on-august-25 This world is set in an alpine, mountainous environment. Sims can go to the Crystal Solarium Rejuvenating Waters and the Zephyr Health Spa or the Museum of Magic and Supernatural.https://www.eurogamer.net/articles/2011-08-04-sims-3-hidden-springs-dlc-announced ==Description== [[File:SIMS3HS Logo.png|left|75px]] '''Explore an All-New World – Discover the Magic of Hidden Springs Today!''' ''Celebrities and the rich flock to Hidden Springs in search of relaxation and escape from the mundane. Many cannot resist rumors of the seemingly miraculous healing powers that linger in the woods and waters. Some of the townsfolk who live in the woods are highly secretive and seem to have a pale green tinge to them. Is it really magic at work?'' '''All-New Gameplay Object''' ''The Fountain of Youth is available exclusively with Hidden Springs and allows you to expand your game with all-new gameplay benefits. Will your Sims choose to become forever young?'' ==Backstory== [[File:Backstory Render HS.png|right]] '''Save Our Princess!''' [[Francisca Vanderburg|Our princess]] has gone missing and we need your help! She probably snuck out again at night in search of that fabled [[Leon's Fountain of Youth|Fountain of Youth]]. Apparently, it’ll make you younger, but I say it’s complete nonsense. I keep telling her these fairy tales don’t exist, yet she just won’t listen to me! Worse yet, my son [[Sebastian Vanderburg|Sebastian]] has been obsessed with finding her and he’s becoming less interested in upholding our family values. This isn’t how our little prince is supposed to behave! How can we possibly win the respect of the citizens of Hidden Springs if our children keep getting into trouble? Please do what it takes to find our princess. I can’t bear to witness the great [[Vanderburg family]] name be sullied any further. -- ''[[Catarina Vanderburg]], Queen of Hidden Springs'' {{clr}} ==Features== [[File:HiddenSpringsLogo01.jpg|thumb|250px|Welcome to Hidden Springs!]] * A Whole New World Awaits - Meet new Sims, explore new locations, and become forever young when you discover the mysterious healing powers of Hidden Springs. * Become Forever Young - Will your Sims uncover the curious magical properties of Hidden Springs? Explore the World and you might discover rejuvenating waters, drink from the [[Leon's Fountain of Youth|Fountain of Youth]] and your Sims wishes just might come true. * Explore New Locations - Hidden Springs is full of all-new locations, lots, and venues. Where will your adventures take you? ** Mingle with the social elites at the Redwood Heights Luxury Lodge. ** Experience true balance and well being as you bask in the ambiance of the Crystal Solarium Rejuvenating Waters. ** Take imagination to another dimension of fun and fairy mischief at Fairyfolk Park. ** Or, head to the Silver Zephyr Health Spa to discover world renowned techniques in the fields of health and beauty. * Exclusive New Items - Customize your game with dozens of all-new exclusive objects, clothing and hair that are only available with Hidden Springs. * All-New Sims and Stories - An exclusive retreat for the rich and the famous? Or a mysterious World with curious healing powers? Whatever the answer, one thing is certain: the Sims you meet in Hidden Springs will have all-new stories that are out of this World. ==Overview== [[File:Hidden springs.jpg|200px|thumb]]
When you're in Hidden Springs, you can explore a stunning lakefront, relax at a luxury spa or ski lodge, escape into the woods, or even uncover ancient mysteries at the Museum of Magic and Supernatural. What will you find in Hidden Springs?
Hidden Springs has some references to the fairy tale [[wikipedia:Cinderella|Cinderella]]: The royalty of the world, the [[Vanderburg family]] is trying to get their "prince," [[Sebastian Vanderburg|Sebastian]] married. [[Lonnie Pertridge]] has a fondest wish to marry her daughters, [[Eunice Pertridge|Eunice]] and [[Astrid Pertridge|Astrid]] to the "prince," and they mistreat [[Ella Carlisle]], Lonnie's step-daughter, who is obliged to perform domestic roles. Following Cinderella story, the "prince" would end up marrying Ella Carlisle and despise Lonnie, Eunice and Astrid. The players are, however, free to choose their fate. Hidden Springs is the richest world in ''The Sims 3''. The richest household from other worlds have [[§]]75,000 in funds, apart from the Goldbeards from [[Barnacle Bay]], who have 150,000 in household funds. Yet the richest household living in Hidden Springs has §175,000 in funds. This is the [[Vanderburg family]] who are known as the ''Royal Family''. Hidden Springs is also one of the smallest towns featured in ''The Sims 3'', having 50 playable Sims, while [[Sunset Valley]] has 68. Because of Hidden Springs mountain theme, most houses are made with wood. The richest households have, however, their houses constructed with different materials. The [[Fountain of Youth]] is supposedly an item that ships with Hidden Springs, however, it has been reported by players that the item is not placed in the town when loaded, or that the item is either too difficult to find. Therefore, the players have to place it themselves if they want to play with it. [[Lunar Lakes]] has references to Hidden Springs, such as a park with Hidden Springs themed stuff. It also has a descendant from the Vanderburgs, [[Sofia Vanderburg]], who, opposed to her monarchic ancestors, is anarchic. ==Lots== ===Community lots=== {{Col-begin}} {{Col-2}} * Beryl Lane Picnic Spot (big park or festival grounds{{Vgversion|TS3:S}}) * Crystal Solarium Rejuvenating Waters (pool) * Eloise C. [[Gregor Bellemy]] (Electrocution) ==Subdistricts== There seems to be significant differences between: *The downtown and hills, which mostly have concrete architecture and a very large paved town square. *The [[Forest (Hidden Springs)|forest]], which has almost solely wooden cabin architecture, dense tree cover, playful parks, and mostly (but not only) dirt roads. The town bio also points out that some of the residents there have a faintly green skin. Worth noting, however, is that neither of the two areas have anything even ''close'' to official, hinted, or implied names for them in-game. ==Notes== * Just like Barnacle Bay, the XML in the world file carries preset celebrity data for Sims in Hidden Springs. So when ''[[The Sims 3: Late Night]]'' is installed, some numbers of Hidden Springs Sims have celebrity status. * Just like [[Barnacle Bay]], [[Monte Vista]] and [[Dragon Valley]], Hidden Springs can be obtained through retail stores: on disc (in US) and as code-in-a-box (outside of US). * Hidden Springs features no [[pregnant]] Sims. * Hidden Springs doesn't have a beach. Instead, the Meadow Beach is assigned to be a [[fishing spot]]. [[File:Lucky Palms Reflect.png|left]]'''Lucky Palms''' is a [[world]] for ''[[The Sims 3]]''. It was announced on June 18, 2012 and released on June 28 of the same year. It is the fifth world released for ''[[The Sims 3 Store]]''.<ref>[http://www.simprograms.com/41773/the-sims-3-lucky-palms/ "The Sims 3 Lucky Palms!"]. ''Beyond Sims''. Retrieved on 22 November 2015.</ref> Lucky Palms is set in a desert setting with small pockets of green scattered throughout the world. There are 53 residents (and 5 unborn babies).

It is available in a Standard and Gold edition. The Gold edition contains The [[Lucky Simoleon Casino]], as well as several extra objects, including the blackjack table and the [[slot machine]].<ref>[https://store.thesims3.com/luckypalms.html "Lucky Palms - Store - The Sims™ 3"]. ''thesims3.com''. Retrieved on 22 November 2015.</ref>

==Description==
[[File:LuckyPalmsLogo.png|75px|left]]'''Explore an All-New World – Discover the Wonders of Lucky Palms Today!'''

''Rest and relaxation is the name of the game at The Sims 3 Lucky Palms! With ample parks, recreation locales, and a thriving culinary scene, you'll find yourself on an oasis of green amid shifting sands. This desert enclave offers manicured gardens, modern estates, and cozy abodes nestled on the banks of a pristine lake. At the heart of town lies a mysterious well that is said to grant wishes to those who are pure of heart…what will you wish for?''

'''All New''': ''The Wishing Well –Does your Sim long for Love? Wealth? Power and Fame? Perhaps they yearn for the pitter patter of little feet, or maybe they just want to be happy… The Wishing Well can help your Sim achieve all of these things and more! Just toss a coin and make a wish and see if dreams come true...''

==Overview==
Lucky Palms is actually two towns in one, segregated by a highway. One side is a resort town, set at the edge of a beautiful blue lake. This side is based on [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Palm_Springs,_California Palm Springs, California], a desert resort and famous playground for the rich and famous in the 1950s and 1960s, an inspiration that can be seen in the mid-century modern architecture and the abundance of palm trees and wind turbines.

On the other side of the highway rests [[Lakeside Drive]], which is three dried up lakes with a small collection of houses and abandoned community lots surrounding it. There is also a gas station, a motel, a pharmacy and a yacht club that have been converted into [[residential lot]]s. This part of the world is based on [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Salton_Sea Salton Sea, California], a once thriving desert resort lake that became mostly abandoned due to rising levels of salinity caused by agricultural runoffs.

There is a [[wishing well#The Sims 3 Store|wishing well]] in the middle of the town, located in the Botanic Garden, just in front of [[city hall]].

The town features two returning Sims from [[Pleasantview]] in ''[[The Sims 2]]'': [[Darren Dreamer]], who is living by himself, and his future wife [[Darleen Matlapin]], living with her parents [[Mariana Matlapin|Mariana]] and [[Omar Matlapin|Omar]].

==Backstory==
[[File:Backstory Render LP.png|right]]
'''[[Darren Dreamer]]'''

Looking for love in Lucky Palms!
Within 3 miles of City Hall, Lucky Palms
:Relationship: Never Married
:Have Kids: No
:Want Kids: With the right woman!
:Profession: Artist!

Darren Dreamer here, artist in residence to the fabulous town of Lucky Palms! And by artist I mean REAL artist, not the bumming on my best friends couch hopefuls! I am a single adult male whose interests include painting, computer games, and preparing grilled cheese sandwiches. I don't really enjoy spending much time outdoors, but I do love painting landscapes!

Something I love about our town of Lucky Palms is how many unique and beautiful things there are to paint. Whether it's the rich orange and reds of the mountains, the desert green on the skin of the cactus, or the rising sun's reflection on the surface of the lake our surroundings are bursting with natural beauty and vibrant color!

The Blooming Cactus Bistro offers the best views of the city at sunset and my place to grab a bite and a bit of inspiration. Are you looking to be inspired? If so, you can find me at 59 Gobi Road. I look forward to meeting you!
{{clr}}

==Families==
===New families===
*'''[[Isadora Bard|Bard family]]''' ''119 Lakeside Drive''
:§10,000
:Difficulty: 1
:[[Isadora Bard]]
:''Isadora needs everything to be shiny! Her hair, her clothes, her imagination, they all shine brighter than the sun. If life gave her lemons Isadora would make lemonade...and she would probably throw a handful of glitter in for good measure.''

*'''[[Best Friends household (Lucky Palms)|Best Friends household]]''' ''13 The Lake''
:§10,000
:Difficulty: 2
:[[Roy Phillips]], [[Palmer Hayes]]
:''Roy and Palmer knew each other as children, but grew apart as the years went by and they followed different paths in life. Reunited when they both happened to retire in the same desert town these two were fast to rekindle their friendship. Roy and Palmer... best friends forever!''

*'''[[Claremont family]]''' ''68 Gobi Road''
:§14,000
:Difficulty: 4
:[[Morgan Claremont]], [[Sammi Claremont]], [[Tabbi Claremont]], [[Endora Kravitz]]
:''When Morgan took a new job in a new town he had no idea that his mother-in-law would be tagging along! What was supposed to be a "short visit" when their first child was born has turned into an extended stay. Will true love triumph over a meddlesome mother-in-law?''

*'''[[Diwan family]]''' ''117 Lakeside Drive''
:§10,000
:Difficulty: 3
:[[Taj Diwan]], [[Zahra Diwan]], [[Sahan Diwan]]
:''Special Agent Taj Diwan is deep undercover in his investigation of the drained lake bed and the Sims who live there! To aid his deception he's brought his family with him. Aided by his dedicated and supportive wife, Zahara, he has infiltrated the small neighborhood and is investigating criminal activities in the area.''

*'''[[Gilbert family]]''' ''121 Lakeside Drive''
:§6,000
: Difficulty: 3
:[[Barry Gilbert]], [[Hanson Gilbert]], [[Joshua Gilbert]]
:''After the death of his beloved wife, Barry felt a change of scene was in order and bought property over a popular online auction site. Unfortunately he paid double what the "cozy lake front abode" was worth and is stuck with his poor investment. The bills are high and the lake is dry... will the family stick together through these tough times?''

*'''[[Golden Gals household]]''' ''21 The Lake''
:§18,000
:Difficulty: 2
:[[Gennie Gomez]], [[Beulah Patterson]], [[Evangeline Finch]]
:''Three gifted women, best friends through thick and thin, are living together during their golden years. Gennie is a talented artist, Beulah is an expert angler, and Evangeline enjoys gardening and hacking. These brilliant women are determined to make the best of the rest of their lives!''

*'''[[Jaycen Hendrix|Hendrix family]]''' ''67 Golf View Road''
:§75,000
:Difficulty: 1
:[[Jaycen Hendrix]]
:''A confirmed bachelor for life, Jaycen works hard and plays harder! He loves fast cars, beautiful women, and a well made grilled cheese sandwich. Can he continue to grow his father's business empire, or will his playboy ways cost him everything?''

*'''[[Hudson Hipsters household]]''' ''79 Sunset Boulevard''
:§15,000
: Difficulty: 2
:[[Kinslee Hudson]], [[Ariel Hudson]]
:''Madly in love and daring enough to break convention, this young couple is pregnant with their first child and shunning the civil trappings of wedlock, though they have decided to share Kinslee's last name. Can these wily hipsters maintain their unique perspective on life amid a more conservative desert crowd?'' 

*'''[[Irwin family]]''' ''130 Lakeside Drive''
:§7,000
:Difficulty: 3
:[[Emi Irwin]], [[Richard Irwin]], [[Cricket Irwin]]
:''Unemployed, unreliable, and unfaithful Richard is hardly a good role model. And though beautiful Emi Irwin is deeply troubled and working on the wrong side of the law... is there any hope for their daughter to have a normal childhood?''

*'''[[King family (Lucky Palms)|King family]]''' ''69 Golf View Road''
:§30,000
:Difficulty: 3
:[[Brayden King]], [[Kadia King]], [[Abrielle King]], [[Abrianna King]]
:''The Kings are pillars of respectability and popularity. Their twin daughters excel scholastically and are both gifted with creative talents. As these two cultivated teens grow into adulthood where will their life paths take them? And what will their parents do once their little birds have flown?''

*'''[[Lola Lancaster|Lancaster family]]''' ''125 Lakeside Drive''
:§5,000
:Difficulty: 1
:[[Lola Lancaster]]
:''Dazzling former showgirl Lola has been entertaining a steady string of gentlemen since the untimely, and according to the police "accidental", death of her husband. But one affair may have gone too far...pregnant and in love with a married man, what's a girl to do?!''

*'''[[Marisol Loera|Loera family]]''' ''66 Sand Road''
:§10,000
:Difficulty: 1
:[[Marisol Loera]]
:''An ambitious young author, Marisol left her fast paced life behind in order to focus on her writing. She is working on her debut novel, a murder mystery set in the town of Hidden Springs during an unrelenting blizzard. Marisol intended to move back home after completing her novel, but a certain police cadet may cause her to relocate permanently...''

*'''[[Lovers? household]]''' ''73 Golf View Road''
:§100,000
:Difficulty: 2
:[[Eli Vokoban]], [[Lina Lancaster]]
:''Eli is a lifelong ladies man and his current lady is the lovely - and much younger - Lina Lancaster. Lina claims to love Eli, but neighbors whisper that she is only in love with his fortune! Rumors say that Lina is pregnant... but is Eli the father?''

*'''[[Kitty Price|Price family]]''' ''75 Golf View Road''
:§45,000
:Difficulty: 1
:[[Kitty Price]]
:''Former starlet and eccentric art collector Kitty divides her time between cooking and decorating her underground girl cave. A former action movie star Kitty first and foremost believes in Girl Power! Rarrr! Will she find a special someone to enjoy her retirement with, or will she scare all the potential suitors away?''

*'''[[Ross family]]''' ''93 Sonora Street''
: §16,000
:Difficulty: 3
:[[Marissa Ross]], [[Phoenix Ross]], [[Addison Ross]]
:''Marissa has been very successful in her pursuit of a top tier business career, but Phoenix has failed to find success in the military. As Marissa spends more and more time at work Phoenix finds himself raising their daughter alone. Will these former lovebirds find their way back to one another, or does a separation loom in the future?''

*'''[[Yolanda Shaw|Shaw family]]''' ''70 Great Sand Road'' 
:§10,000
:Difficulty: 1
:[[Yolanda Shaw]]
:''Short skirts and persistent flirts, Yolanda likes the boys and the boys like her! This good time gal shirks responsibility and hates to be tied down, but recently she noticed some changes in her daily routine. Is she really expecting a baby? If so, can she possibly put her fast paced life on hold to raise a child alone?''

*'''[[Lennon Sosa|Sosa family]]''' ''71 Golf View Road''
:§20,000
:Difficulty: 1
:[[Lennon Sosa]]
:''A top student from the prestigious Formage Grille cooking school, Lennon has a big appetite and even bigger dreams! Known for his lavish parties, robust garden, and scrumptious cuisine he quickly became a town favorite, but can he surpass Romon Tanner and become known as the number one chef in town?''

*'''[[Sparks family]]''' ''95 Sonora Street''
: §12,000
:Difficulty: 2
:[[Walker Sparks]], [[Piper Sparks]]
:''Widowed when his daughter was just a baby, Walker has struggled to balance his career and raise his child. His want to provide Piper with financial security has turned him into a workaholic and an absent father. Too late Walker sees the damage that has been done... can he mend his relationship with his daughter before he loses her forever.''

*'''[[Donnovan Steel|Steel family]]''' ''77 Sunset Boulevard''
:§12,000
: Difficulty: 1
:[[Donnovan Steel]]
:''A young cadet with a winning smile and a passion for justice, Donnovan is the face of the police force, literally! He was recently featured on the cover of the annual "Hot Desert Cops" calendar. Will this young enforcer stay on the correct side of the law, or will fame lead him astray?''

*'''[[Naomi Nita|Survivalist household]]''' ''18 The Lake'' 
:§10,000
:Difficulty: 1
:[[Naomi Nita]]
:''Naomi's motto is "Prepare for the worst so that you will survive the zombie apocalypse." Her home is small and sparse, but her underground bunker is designed to outlast anything the world throws at her. Rumor has it that she is investigating a long life serum on the side while pursuing her job as a scientist.''

*'''[[Tanner family]]''' ''96 Sonora Street''
:§25,000
:Difficulty: 3
:[[Romon Tanner]], [[Aya Tanner]], [[Ethan Tanner]], [[Yuna Tanner]]
:''Four generations of cooking excellence define the Tanner family name, but now has an upstart with a fancy pedigree has come to challenge the Tanners as the best chefs in town. Will Ethan's home grown culinary skills triumph over the formal training of his nemesis?''

*'''[[The Unlikely Twosome household]]''' ''118 Lakeside Drive''
:§4,000
:Difficulty: 2
:[[Ezekiel Reid]], [[Pansy Northrop]]
:''Ezekiel inherited his father's home back when there was still a lake. Unfortunately for him, when the water vanished the real estate's value did too. :§10,000
:Difficulty: 2
:[[Oscar Arellano]], [[Vivienne Vasquez]], [[Clark Bellamore]]
:''Young lovers Vivienne and Oscar relocated after Viv was offered her dream job at the local science lab. Oscar's best friend Clark tagged along, but, unable to find work, ended up crashing permanently on their couch. Can this young romance survive their unexpected house guest?''

:§20,000
:Difficulty: 1
:[[Darren Dreamer]]
:''A talented artist with eccentric tastes, Darren hates the outdoors, yet has a passion for painting landscapes through large windows. Rumor has it that his home came with a swimming pool, but he had it filled in so he could build a cactus garden in his backyard. Though art is his passion, being a stay-at-home bachelor is lonely business... is there a special Sim somewhere who is a perfect match for Darren?''

*'''[[Matlapin family]]''' ''74 Pleasant View Road''

: Difficulty: 2

Their daughter Darleen has a dreamy disposition and an interest in the arts... and romance! Will Darleen find the man of her dreams amid the shifting sands?''

==Trivia==
*All the [[rabbit holes]] (except the [[Bistro]]) are recolored versions of the ones in [[Sunset Valley]].
*Sedona Lane in Lucky Palms refers to the [[Unreleased_neighborhoods#Sedona|beta]] desert [[neighborhood]] of ''[[The Sims 2]]'' called Sedona.
*Lucky Palms is one of the locations where postcards can be obtained from in ''[[The Sims 4]]''.
*The Young Trio household's story and situation is similar to the plot of the movie ''You, Me, and Dupree''.
*Lucky Palms was the first world in ''The Sims 3'' to feature new trees.
*The design and theme of Lucky Palms was inspired by Palm Springs and Las Vegas, as well as desert towns in California and Nevada.
*The description of ''Western Ways'', a painting in ''[[The Sims 3: Movie Stuff]]'', states that it was painted by a Lucky Palms resident.

[[File:Sunlit Tides Reflect.png|left]]'''Sunlit Tides''' is a world from ''[[TheSims3.com|The Sims 3 Store]]'', and it was announced on August 15, 2012. It is based on a tropical island with sparkling beaches and palm trees. It was released on August 23, 2012. Sunlit Tides is more expensive than previous towns at 3,915 (39 USD) SimPoints for the gold version and 2,450 (24 USD) SimPoints for the standard version. The town features new rabbit holes and the [[Pleasant family]].

==Description==
[[File:Sunlit Tides Logo.png|75px|left]]
'''Explore an All-New World – Discover the Wonders of Sunlit Tides!'''

''A modern downtown gives way to a lush jungle sprinkled with exotic bungalows and waterfront vacation homes nestled between the gentle waves of the ocean and a sun kissed lagoon. Enjoy a picnic on the beach, plan a secret rendezvous at an island waterfall, or cozy up to a loved one in the shade of a palm tree and watch the sun sink into the sea. Will your Sims find true love, or just have fun trying?''
{{clr}}

==Backstory==
[[File:Backstory Render ST.png|right]]
'''Looking for recruits to relocate immediately!'''

I am Alana Kahale, and I am proud to be the third generation running the family business here in Sunlit Tides!

So what do we have to offer? How about generous salaries, a fun and challenging work environment, and a full relocation package to the beautiful island of Sunlit Tides! On your days off enjoy world class fishing, pristine beaches, and sultry steams in the sauna. All houses feature stunning ocean or lagoon views. Interested yet?

'''Job Requirements:'''

*Strong athletic skills a must.
*Excellent communication skills – verbal, written, and groveling.
*Demonstrated ability to manage and communicate through bribery.
*Previous work experience involving conspiracy, intimidation, or scandals preferred.
*A predisposition for "thievery" or "evil"

No previous experience required!

Please apply in person at The Lair, Sunlit Tides. Look for the cleverly disguised [[volcano]] atop a mountain. If you fall off the cliff… you've gone too far.

Looking forward to hearing from you!

- [[Alana Kahale]]
{{clr}}

==Families==
===New families===
*'''[[Adams family]]''' ''4 Reef Road''
:§80,000
:Difficulty: 3
:[[Iris Adams]], [[Alastair Adams]], [[Milton Adams]]
:''With a hefty divorce settlement in tow, Iris Adams is in search of closure and a fresh start for her and her two sons, Alastair and Milton. Alastair is finally coming into his own with music and a teen romance, but Milton seems stuck in his shell. Can this family recover and rebuild?''

*'''[[Silas Allender|Allender family]]''' ''12 Tropical Circle''
:§20,000
:Difficulty: 1
:[[Silas Allender]]
:''For Silas this picturesque island is just another assignment in yet another town and his burgeoning "romance" with Talei Hale comes with the job. But when he starts getting actual feelings for Iris Adams he begins to wonder if it's time to put his life as a spy aside in search of something more...''

*'''[[Beach Bums household]]''' ''31 Paradise Circle''
:§16,000
:Difficulty: 2
:[[Ricardo Gregario]], [[Len Tsang]], [[Suzuki Hinata]]
:''Ricardo, Len, and Suzuki have lived together since the day they graduated high school. But when his roommates grew out of their youthful awkwardness into attractive young adults, Ricardo can't help but feel left behind. Can his friends help give him the confidence to go after the girl of his dreams?''

*'''[[Best Friends household (Sunlit Tides)|Best Friends household]]''' ''52 Paradise Circle''
:§12,000
:Difficulty: 2
:[[Ursula Lemuel]], [[Theodora Jayne]]
:''Ursula brought her best friend, Theodora, to the island in hopes that she'd finally unwind! Her friend has everything going for her, beauty, smarts and an amazing body, but she constantly hides away. Ursula wants to bring the fun out of Theodora but doesn't intend to stay indoors and wait while there is fun to be had... there are men on this island. Plenty of men!''

*'''[[Carnegie family]]''' ''54 Paradise Circle''
:§26,000
:Difficulty: 4
:[[Eugene Carnegie]], [[Ethel Carnegie]], [[Edmund Carnegie]], [[Elosie Carnegie]]
:''When Eugene takes a step back and looks at his life this is not how he imagined it... A much needed respite in paradise is being ruined by his domineering wife who can't stop bossing him around long enough to enjoy the sunshine. His son is cowering further into the shadows and his daughter just can't be tamed. Can Eugene find peace on this island vacation, or will chaos rule supreme?''

*'''[[Maria Ernest|Ernest family]]''' ''5 Mango Way''
:§20,000
:Difficulty: 1
:[[Maria Ernest]]
:''When Maria was younger her mother swore that she would want more out of life; a husband, a "regular" job, and a family, but in her heart Maria always knew that her first love was the sea. As the best angler on the island, Maria has no shortage of friends and enjoys her quiet life spent fishing along the endless tracts of beach.''

*'''[[Fitzpatrick family]]''' ''56 Paradise Circle''
:§50,000
:Difficulty: 2
:[[Niles Fitzpatrick]], [[Isadora Fitzpatrick]]
:''Niles and Isadora love their life together. Without children neither their bodies or wallets have been ravaged by the sands of time. Now in their old age they enjoy the peaceful elegance of island life. Lobster Thermidor anyone?''

*'''[[Gilberto Gonzalo|Gonzalo family]]''' ''33 Paradise Circle''
:§25,000
:Difficulty: 1
:[[Gilberto Gonzalo]]
:''Gilberto is a star and he knows it! All of the men want to be him and the women want to be with him! When a recruiter for the Sunset Valley Llamas offers him a spot on their all-star team he's torn: take the opportunity of a lifetime, or stay here in comfort as the biggest fish in his small pond?''

*'''[[Grantham family]]''' ''1 Oceanside''
:§20,000
:Difficulty: 4
:[[Gavin Grantham]], [[Alice Grantham]], [[Sophie Grantham]], [[Katherine Grantham]]
:''Gavin had it all planned out for a son. Football in the yard, teaching him to drive, telling him how to treat a girl at prom, but when his wife Alice had a baby girl and followed by ANOTHER girl he's concerned that a baby boy is a long way off... He's brought his family to the island to get some rest and relaxation before he asks his wife to try just one more time for the son of his dreams. Little do they know there is a surprise in store for them all!''

*'''[[Hale family]]''' ''11 Paradise Circle''
:§120,000
:Difficulty: 3
:[[Kimo Hale]], [[Talei Hale]], [[Kiwi Hale]]
:''Kimo likes order in his home, in his life, and, most importantly, in his work. Talei fears her cold husband and spends her time sheltering their son, ensuring he gets all of the love he needs. When the mysterious Silas Allender starts showing her warm romantic attentions, she can't help but wonder what the future might be like with someone new...''

*'''[[Hoffman family (Sunlit Tides)|Hoffman family]]''' ''2 Lagoon Beach''
:§45,000
:Difficulty: 4
:[[Hazel Hoffman]], [[Hugh Hoffman]], [[Helen Hoffman]], [[Hector Hoffman]]
:''Hazel loves her family more than she can say, but being a super wife to a successful husband and raising two wonderful children has left her tired and stressed. When Hugh offers a stay on an island paradise she jumps at the chance to relax and maybe leave her husband with the kids for the day... with family bonding at an all time high is there any reason for the Hoffmans to ever leave the island?''

*'''[[Kahale family]]''' ''9 Paradise Circle''
:§200,000
:Difficulty: 3
:[[Alana Kahale]], [[Kai Kahale]], [[Lealani Kahale]]
:''Kai and Alana Kahale rule the island with iron wills and nerves of steel! Alana's brilliance keeps Kai at the top of his game and Kai’s fearsome presence and political clout keep Alana out of any real danger. With their passions well in hand, their biggest focus in life is making sure their beautiful daughter lives the life of her wildest dreams…will Lealani follow in her parents' footsteps, or choose a different path?''

*'''[[Keanu Keilani|Keilani family]]''' ''34 Paradise Circle''
:§15,000
:Difficulty: 1
:[[Keanu Keilani]]
:''Keanu has lived on the island his entire life. It didn't take long for him to realize that he associated more with things than with people. Over the years he's found beauty in all parts of the island and the treasures in his collection make his life whole. So what if people in the town don't understand him? Who needs people…he has his treasures. They'll understand.''

*'''[[Mango family]]''' ''1 Mango Way''
:§10,000
:Difficulty: 1
:[[Maru Mango]]
:''Maru Mango has always marched to the beat of his own drummer, a.k.a. "Mitch", a figment of his imagination who talks to him every other day. So it was a surprise to him and everyone in town when he got the job to run the island's military... mostly because no one else applied. Will the voices in his head help bring stability to the island, or do they have a secret agenda Maru knows nothing about?''

*'''[[Pepper family]]''' ''5 Reef Road''
:§25,000
:Difficulty: 3
:[[Laurita Pepper]], [[Penelope Pepper]], [[Martin Pepper]]
:''Martin hoped that the beautiful scenery and change of pace would help mend his family after the death of his father. Sadly, as his mother continues to retreat into depression and his sister continues to retreat into selfish disregard, he knows it's up to him to set his family right. But is the burden too much for one so young?''

*'''[[Strong family]]''' ''49 Paradise Circle''
:§24,000
:Difficulty: 2
:[[Julian Strong]], [[Maggie Strong]]
:''After the death of his wife, Julian has had the hardest time connecting with his daughter. From hairstyles, to wardrobe, to puberty, life has been hard on the Strong family, and teenage Maggie is showing some signs of wear. Julian is worried that his wonderful daughter won't be the woman he knows she can be, but when she starts bringing around young Edmund Carnegie he has to decide whether or not he can let his daughter be the woman she wants to be...''

*'''[[Kaila Swift|Swift family]]''' ''6 Silent Shores''
:§25,000
:Difficulty: 1
:[[Kaila Swift]]
:''Kaila is one of the best chefs on the island. She can make the most amazing food out of the ingredients that she finds or grows, but her mysterious, eccentric manner has the townspeople wondering if she isn't also cooking up something else as well! Just what is it she does all day at the science lab?''

*'''[[Wahine family]]''' ''25 Paradise Circle''
:§40,000
:Difficulty: 4
:[[Leo Wahine]], [[Sera Wahine]], [[Tenika Wahine]], [[Luna Wahine]], [[Twikki Wahine]]
:''Leo and Sera are the island favorites. Married straight out of high school, they went straight to work filling their home with lots of kids, and lots of love. But Tenika is grown up and in love with a man her father refuses to accept... will she bend to her family's wishes, or risk their disapproval in the name of love?''

*'''[[Eleanor Waterson|Waterson family]]''' ''10 Azure Avenue''
:§20,000
:Difficulty: 1
:[[Eleanor Waterson]]
:''Eleanor lives in the quiet comfort of a fulfilled life. Since her husband Hal passed away, she's spent the endless days watching the comings and goings on the island while waiting for her own final sunset... but a friend recently told her they saw Hal’s ghost in the graveyard. Is it possible that these two lovers could be reunited in this world?''

*'''[[Pearl Yang|Yang family]]''' ''35 Paradise Circle''
:§20,000
:Difficulty: 1
:[[Pearl Yang]]
:''As the most beautiful girl in town, Pearl has been the center of attention all of her life. But when her life-changing scientific advances go unnoticed she can't help but wonder if her beauty is all that she'll be known for. She's dying to find someone who sees the real her, inside and out...''

*'''[[Young Romance household]]''' ''58 Paradise Circle''
:§10,000
:Difficulty: 2
:[[Alonso Candelaria]], [[Rosalind Cruzita]]
:''Rosalind couldn't believe her luck when handsome Alonso Candelaria said he was crazy about her, and she really couldn't believe it when he proposed a romantic getaway! Perhaps it was being so smitten that clouded her eyes to the fact that he's been spending an awful lot of time with the other young women they met on the beach?''

===Returning families===
*'''[[Alto family]]''' ''16 Tropical Circle''
:§100,000
:Difficulty: 1
:[[Griffin Alto]]
:''Griffin left home on a trek to "find himself" before settling down into the drudgery of the family business, but, once on the island, he immediately fell for a tropical beauty and decided his future would be wherever she is… Will Griffin be able to convince Leo that he is worthy of Tenika’s hand, or will Griffin have to take more drastic measures?''

*'''[[Parrott family]]''' ''14 Tropical Circle''
:§24,000
:Difficulty: 2
:[[Clementine Parrott]], [[Lucretia Parrott]], [[Ramona Parrott]]
:''Clementine couldn't believe that she actually agreed to live with her sisters. Her sister Lucretia spends her nights out on the town and her days on the beach, and her sister Ramona can't sit still long enough to find a focus of her own. Even though they're triplets, Clementine can't help but wonder: When will her sisters ever grow up?''

*'''[[Pleasant family]]''' ''1 Ocean Overlook''
:§25,000
:Difficulty: 2
:[[Daniel Pleasant]], [[Mary-Sue Pleasant]]
:''Daniel and Mary Sue Pleasant are as pleasant as their name implies. After a beautiful whirlwind wedding, they've come to the island for a relaxing honeymoon. The world is their oyster and their marriage is sure to stay this blissful forever... right?''

==Trivia==
*All the Sims from the world lack individual personal biographies. All female playable Sims have the biography "What a wonderful island! I love the deep blue sea and the lush green of the jungle.", while all male playable Sims have the biography "This island is fantastic! Beautiful beaches and great fishing!". Sunlit Tides is the first world in ''The Sims 3'' to have biographies written in first-person perspective.
*In terms of clothing, many Sims in the island are barefoot in their casual wear, but they are all barefoot when in their formal wear.
*This town is based around [[Theme (geography)#Pacific Ocean (excluding Hawaii)|Pacific Ocean-esque]] tropical atolls with volcanic activity and significant Polynesian population percentages, somewhat similarly to what the case is for [[Felicity Island]],{{Vgversion|TSCS}} [[Wanmami Island]],{{Vgversion|TSCS}} and [[Sulani]].{{Vgversion|TS4:OL}}
*With ''[[The Sims 3: Seasons]]'', it is possible to set the game's seasons and [[precipitation]]s to make Sunlit Tides a tropical area.
*It is unclear as to why Daniel Pleasant resides in this world as an adult and not [[Jeff Pleasant]] or [[Diane Pleasant]] as a child as ''[[The Sims 3]]'' takes place before the events of ''[[The Sims]]'', meaning Daniel would not be born yet. However, [[Barnacle Bay]] does take place after the events of ''[[The Sims 2]]'' so it's possible that Sunlit Tides takes place between the events of ''The Sims'' and ''The Sims 2'' as [[Angela Pleasant|Angela]] and [[Lilith Pleasant]] are not born yet and Daniel and Mary-Sue are on their honeymoon, however there is no confirmation of this. 
**An adult [[Jennifer Burb]] and [[Johnny Burb]] also appear in [[Dragon Valley]] without Diane, Jeff, [[Tiffany Burb]] and [[Brad Burb]] which could also put Sunlit Tides in the same possible timeline as Dragon Valley as it should be noted [[Lucy Burb]] is not born yet.
*There is a glitch in this world where if there is [[snow]]{{Vgversion|TS3:S}} on the ground, the snow near the sea may turn a mixture of pixelated colors, mostly yellow, red and pink. This is most common on operating systems such as [[Microsoft Windows|Windows]] XP and Windows 11. This is usually only during world view and shouldn't affect players in Sim view.
*A fairly high percentage of entry-priced houses on the atoll are packed into small lot sizes (Several as small as 15x10[[sq]]) with pretty much no outdoor space, in fact so little space that the [[Wellsian Time Portal]]{{Vgversion|TS3:ITF}} does not auto-spawn on those lots during the [[Moving#The Sims 3|move-in procedure]]. The Time Portal will instead spawn on a random community lot.

[[File:Monte Vista Reflect.png|left]]'''Monte Vista''' is the seventh world from ''[[The Sims 3 Store]]'', released for purchase in The Sims 3 Store on December 6, 2012. Monte Vista is an Italian-themed world, with hills surrounding the world and a coast which leads to an open sea.

The world is available for purchase through retail stores, or through The Sims 3 Store. In The Sims 3 Store, it can only be purchased in cash and not with SimPoints. However, part of the purchase price of the world is a bundle of SimPoints for use in The Sims 3 Store. Currently the two bundles are:
* Monte Vista, plus 100 SimPoints, at US$25<ref>It also costs SG$26 and AU$20.</ref>
* Monte Vista, plus 1900 SimPoints, at US$35<ref>It also costs SG$42 and AU$33.</ref>

==Description==
[[File:Monte Vista Logo.png|left|75px]]''At Monte Vista you can discover a landscape rich with charm and money, where villas featuring sweeping views dot the gently rolling hills. Explore the vibrant community by visiting renowned museums, taking a stroll across the piazza, or learning the culinary arts on an authentic wood-fire oven. Fill your Sims’ homes with the smell of fresh-baked pizzas, calzones, lasagnas and breads. Will your Sims find the inspiration to fuel their culinary fires?''

==Backstory==
[[File:Backstory Render MV.png|right]]
'''Recipes from the Beyond '''

'''Vol. 1'''

I know what you’re thinking. What does a dead guy know about baking? This dead guy knows it all. I’m [[Valentine Monty]] and the Montys have been a part of Monte Vista for as long as anyone can remember. Now that I’ve gotten my second chance I’m giving you all of the “to die for” Monty dishes in my new series: Recipes from the Beyond!

Now here’s the recipe for my world famous Pizza Margherita and it all starts with a fresh lump of dough and a wood fire oven:

:1. Pull a lump of lightly-oiled dough from your refrigerator.
:2.Lay the dough on the counter and knead it carefully and thoroughly until fairly flat
:3.Toss the dough in the air to achieve perfect flatness and perfect lift.

Now for the hard part:

:4. When the dough is flat, sprinkle it with “Monte Vista Magic Seasonings”. This invisible magic seasoning is a MUST for any wood fire oven recipe.
:5. Once properly sprinkled use the paddle to place the pizza in the Wood Fire Oven. Safety First!
:6. Cook until nice and toasty.

What about the cheese and tomatoes you ask? What did you think we were doing with all of that sprinkling? When your pizza comes out of the oven, the toppings will be perfectly arranged making for a '''*perfect*''' pizza margherita. That’s it from me. Until next time, Buonasera!

==Features==
*'''The Wood Fire Oven''' - Expand your Sims' culinary world with new recipes! Make a variety of Breads, Calzones, Lasagnas and Pizzas!
*'''A Whole New World Awaits''' - Meet new Sims, explore new locations, and experience the gorgeous views of Monte Vista!
*'''Exclusive New Items''' - Customize your game with dozens of all-new exclusive objects and clothing that are only available in Monte Vista.
*'''The Sims 2 Legacy Family''' – Meet the Monty Family from Veronaville! Before they started their dire feud with the Capps, the Monty family spent their time whiling away their days peacefully in Monte Vista.

==Families==
There are 27 families in Monte Vista.

===New families===
*'''[[Almeria family]]''' ''21 Verona Way''
:§20,000
:Difficulty: 3
:[[Adora Almeria]], [[Diego Almeria]], [[Marta Almeria]]
:''Adora and Diego Almeria came to town looking for a fresh start. They've always had trouble fitting in, but want more for their perfect baby girl Marta. Can Marta's bright future compete with her parent's awkward past?''

*'''[[Bianchi family]]''' ''6 Regalia Court''
:§20,000
:Difficulty: 3
:[[Franco Bianchi]], [[Kaela Bianchi]], [[Beppe Bianchi]]
:''Franco Bianchi had a dream of being a sports star, but when his whirlwind romance brought a new wife and a son, he realized that it may be time to leave his dreams to support his family. He thinks a life of crime can bring the quick money he needs, but can he keep his family safe?''

*'''[[Costa family]]''' ''11 Regalia Court''
:§30,000
:Difficulty: 4
:[[Dante Costa]], [[Giovanna Costa]], [[Cipriana Costa]], [[Victoria Costa]]
:''Costa is the name to fear in town. If you see a Costa, make room. If you cross a Costa, you'll pay. Dante Costa is the king of crime and he's heavily devoted to his family and his people. Your best chance is to get on his good side...and fast.''

*'''[[DeLuca family]]''' ''31 Verona Way''
:§10,000
:Difficulty: 3
:[[Dario DeLuca]], [[Veronica DeLuca]], [[Teresa DeLuca]]
:''The DeLuca family has a lot of love. Dario is a sweet, sloppy scientist married to the love of his wife Veronica, the smart, sharp squad leader, with their daughter a stylish, self-confident student named Teresa. What's not to love?''

*'''[[Gino Ferrari|Ferrari family]]''' ''16 Regalia Court''
:§20,000
:Difficulty: 1

:''Gino Ferrari isn't just a world famous chef, he's a household name! Between the photoshoots, television appearances, and a demanding relationship with the most beautiful girl in town, he spends all of his time working out instead of enjoying his food! Will this foodie get out of gym long enough to enjoy life?''

*'''[[James household]]''' ''731 Bella Vista Drive''
:§15,000
:Difficulty: 2

In town for work, they still do their best to blend in with the crowd in the hopes that the only photos taken of them will be the ones they get paid for.''

As the last in the Lombardi line, she wants to restore the name of Lombardi in town, but she's going to have to work her way up the political ladder, one rung at a time.''

*'''[[Giacomo Modena|Modena family]]''' ''80 Desdamona Drive''

*'''[[Pepe Moretti|Moretti family]]''' ''23 Verona Way''

==Pre-Release==
===Announcement===
Monte Vista was announced on October 10, 2012 in the Maxis live broadcast. There were no rumors to the world before the announcement. It also features a premium content known as '''The Woodfire Oven''', which Sims cook new recipes such as pizzas, calzones and lasagnes. On November 21, there was an announcement stating that Monte Vista would be available for purchase from the store in '''December 6, 2012''' and from retail stores in '''January 8, 2013'''.

===Live Chat===
A live chat was announced on November 21, 2012 and broadcast on November 27 at 10am PST/6pm GMT. Lisa Smith and Sarah Holding, the producers of Monte Vista and the hosts for the chat, gave an in-depth walkthrough of the town and questions from the community were answered.<ref>http://www.origin.com/sims-3-monte-vista-chat</ref>

According to the live chat:
*Monte Vista is fully compatible with ''[[The Sims 3: Seasons]]''.
*There are various mixed rabbit holes.
*Several Sims from [[Veronaville]] from ''[[The Sims 2]]'' made a comeback to this town for ''[[The Sims 3]]'', such as the [[Monty family]].

==Trivia==
*Several street names are referenced to make Monte Vista Italian-themed.
**''Desdamona'' Drive - [[Wikipedia:Desdemona (Othello)|Desdemona]] (in a play [[Wikipedia:Othello|Othello]]) is the name of a character who is Venetian, a person who lives in Venice, '''Italy'''.
**''Verona'' Way and Via ''Verona''ville - [[Wikipedia:Verona|Verona]] is a city in the Veneto region at northern '''Italy'''. Verona is famous for the play ''[[Wikipedia:Romeo and Juliet|Romeo and Juliet]]'' and in ''[[The Sims 2]]'', for [[Veronaville]].
**''Toscana'' Drive - Toscana is [[Wikipedia:Tuscany|Tuscany]] in Italian, a region in '''Italy'''.
**''Bella'' Vista Drive - [[Wikipedia:Bella|Bella]] is "beautiful" in '''Italian'''. It may be referenced to [[Bella Goth]] as well, and "Bellavista" is also the Italian name for [[Pleasantview]].
**''Stella'' Street - [[Wikipedia:Stella|Stella]] is "star" in '''Italian'''.
**''Regalia'' Court - [[Wikipedia:Regalia|Regalia]] means the privileges (e.g. executive power) and the insignia (e.g. crowns and other symbols of office) characteristic of a sovereign, or ruler, in Latin.
*A few street names are used from ''[[Veronaville]]''.
**Avon Avenue
**Bard Boulevard
**Chorus Court
**Stratford Street
**Via Veronaville
* Due to the appearance of the Monty family, the numerous shared street names, some which directly mention Veronaville, the presence of [[Octavius Capp]] in the local graveyard as well the similar architecture, some players have theorized that Monte Vista in fact is Veronaville, or that the towns are close together, similar to the connection between [[Sunset Valley]], [[Neighborhood 1]] and [[Pleasantview]]. However, Monte Vista is entirely based on Italy, while Veronaville has a comparatively small "Italian" side, with the majority of it's buildings being in a decidedly Northern European style.
*"Monte Vista" is a partial phonetic anagram of "Mona Lisa", a famous painting made by an Italian artist called Leonardo Da Vinci. The phrase itself roughly translates to "Mountain View".
[[File:16th_Century_Monte_Vista_Globe_Bar.png|thumb|16th Century Monte Vista Globe Bar.]]
*Monte Vista is themed after a typical Italian hilltop town and resembles cities in the [[Wikipedia:Tuscany|Tuscany]] region of Italy, including [[Wikipedia:Volterra|Volterra]] and [[Wikipedia:Monteriggioni|Monteriggioni]].
*As noted by Rebecca Sherin, the town was based on San Gimignano <ref>[http://rjshearin.com/worlds.html Rebecca Shearin Worlds]</ref>
*Monte Vista is mentioned in the object description of the "16th Century Monte Vista Bar Globe" from ''[[The Sims 4: Vintage Glamour Stuff]]''. It was created by a Sim named J. Marano.
*Monte Vista is mentioned in the object description of the "Aesthetically Messy Pizza Station" from ''[[The Sims 4: Home Chef Hustle Stuff]]''.

[[File:Aurora Skies Reflect.png|left]]'''Aurora Skies''' is the eighth world from ''[[The Sims 3 Store]]'', it was released for purchase on The Sims 3 Store on February 21, 2013.<ref>''[http://forum.thesims3.com/jforum/posts/list/641150.page http://forum.thesims3.com/jforum/posts/list/641150.page]''</ref><ref>''[http://www.thesims3.com/myBlog.html?persona=SimGuruTaterTot&month=01&year=2013 SimGuruTaterTot] (TheSims3.com)''</ref> Aurora Skies is a Nordic (majority-Icelandic) coastal town-themed world. The standard version of the world costs 2,205 SimPoints while the gold version costs 3,915 SimPoints.

A large majority of the inspiration is taken from Iceland, with some main street building styles and Sim names (e.g. [[Jakob Ingberg]], [[Viktor Valquist]]) appearing to be Swedish, and a fair few Sim names (e.g. [[Oskar Olsen]], [[Arvid Oss]]) and one street name (Hovedgaten) being Norwegian.

==Description==
[[File:Aurora Skies Logo.png|left|90px]]'''Explore an All-New World – Discover the Wonders of Aurora Skies!'''

''Explore the breathtaking scenery and vast, unspoiled nature that await you at Aurora Skies! This quaint, coastal town features the very best in outdoor living: grow your family on spacious land and houses surrounded by an eco-friendly community, traipse under majestic, towering waterfalls that come to rest on the banks of a large, steaming geothermal lake sky, or take a night hike under the dome of the bright, multi-colored sky. It’s the ultimate getaway for Sims searching for change, searching for themselves, or searching for a piece of peace. What will you find at Aurora Skies?''

==Backstory==
[[File:Backstory Render AS.png|right]]
;Do it for science!
Science is everywhere around us, but at Aurora Skies it’s not just something you learn; it’s something you do!  We need bright young minds to make the dreams of the future a reality.

Even now we’re finding more uses for garbage to help the planet. Charging batteries, powering machines - the sky is the limit. Just this last year we created a modified [[Hot Air Balloon]] using garbage as fuel and turning it into pure air with a pine breeze scent.  Now you can have efficient travel and an amazing romantic adventure with no cost to the ozone (or your nose)!

Every year we’re creating more and more exciting things in the world of science. Garbage-powered hearts, heart-powered cars, solar-powered cats; what will you think of next!  It’s all up to you. Do it for Science!

Did you know?

Hot Air Balloons are an epic form of travel based around the simple principle that hot air is lighter than cold air.  They lift in the air based on the heat system in the balloon. Increasing the temperature of the air inside the balloon makes it lighter than the air outside and the balloon begins to float.  More air is required to lift heavier things; that’s why the balloons have to be so huge! How cool (or hot!) is that?

==Trivia==
*Aurora Skies is [[Theme (geography)#Nordic countries|Nordic-themed]], focusing especially on Iceland.
**Specifically Nordic-themed towns would later return in ''[[The Sims 4: Businesses & Hobbies]]'' with the town of [[Nordhaven]], and to a much smaller extent ''[[The Sims 4: Get Together]]'' with [[Lykke Centre]] in [[Windenburg]] loosely based on upperclass trendy Copenhagen areas and the Denmark-Germany border areas.
*With the return of the [[Beaker family]], the timeline in Aurora Skies is confirmed to occur before ''[[The Sims 2]]'' era.
*Some community lots in Aurora Skies are assigned to be either visitors allowed or no visitors allowed, even though they should obviously be assigned to a more specific / suitable [[lot assignment]]. These include Björn Café (bar or hangout), Fiskar Fishing Park (fishing spot), Lend and Learn Library (library), Sundhöll Community Pool (pool), and The Blue Lagoon (bar or hangout).
*All the Sims from the world lack individual personal biographies. All female playable Sims have the biography "The women of Aurora Skies seem to get prettier every year. I think there's something in the water.", while all male playable Sims have the biography "Something about Aurora Skies brings out the best in men... especially this one.".
*Velkominn is the translation of 'Welcome' in Icelandic.
*There is an [[List of glitches (The Sims 3 era)|issue]] in Aurora Skies where the snow is discolored in the winter, due to the terrain being too close to sea level. A player-created fix can be found [https://potato-ballad-sims.tumblr.com/post/177355341248/i-always-thought-aurora-skies-was-one-of-the here].
*In regards to Hovedgaten Road, "Hovedgaten" is Norwegian for "Main Street", resulting in the slightly odd meaning of "Main Street Road".
*On The Sims 3 store, Aurora Skies's gold edition is the only world with accidental pricing; gold editions of store worlds offer the world and an extra venue and/or sets that released alongside the world on the store and offer a cheaper price for SimPoints than if you were to buy then individually. With Aurora Skies, however, the gold edition is priced at 4,307 SimPoints including the Aurora Skies world and the Tiny Prodegies Early Learning Center venue, but Aurora Skies's standard with just the world is priced at 2,426 SimPoints and the Tiny Prodegies venue is priced at 1,539 SimPoints; if you were to buy them separately it costs 3,965 SimPoints, which is 342 SimPoints cheaper than the gold edition.

Dragon Valley.text: {{Pagecover |image = World_ScreenshotWeb_DragonValley016.jpg |name = Dragon Valley |pagetype = Downloadable [[World]] |subtitle = |TS3SE|toc = |gen = TS3}} {{Infobox world |name = Dragon Valley |image = [[File:Dragon Valley thumbnail.png|250px]] |caption = Welcome to Dragon Valley, a land of myth and fantasy.
